title: Recognizes arrays, null values and basic types
goal: Combines typeof, strict comparison, and Array.isArray to distinguish common types.
summary: The input tool receives different types of values and needs to distinguish between real null values, missing parameters and ordinary objects.
tasks: completes kindOf(value), array returns "array", null returns "null".
Other inputs return the result of typeof. Returns "undefined" when no parameters are passed.

example.code:
typeof 12; // 'number'
Array.isArray([]); // true
null === null; // true
example.note: typeof null and typeof [] will both get object, handle these two cases separately first.

hint: first determines value === null and Array.isArray(value), and then returns typeof value.
